name: Kayte Kitchen
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Admirari Nature Therapy offers an alternative to traditional counselling services. Nature is an amazing therapist and we facilitate safe spaces for her to do her work. Sessions are almost always outside and can include nature based activities, creative responses to nature, contemplative moments or opportunities to learn from nature.

name: Kim Gotlieb
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Psychotherapy and Counselling can create a safe and supportive opportunity to lean into whatever may be limiting your sense of freedom and vitality. My work is trauma-informed, making space to support strategies which encourage the ability to down-regulate over-stimulated nervous systems. As a gay man I have found the expanding conversation around LGBTIQA+, gender identity and sexual orientation continue to grow as I welcome these client groups into my practice.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma

name: Kim Parsons
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: White Dove Counselling Services At White Dove Counselling Services, we are committed to providing compassionate, professional, and client-centred counselling support for individuals, adolescents, and families as they navigate life’s challenges. Based in Croydon South, Victoria, our practice offers a warm, safe, and non-judgmental environment where clients can feel heard, supported, and empowered throughout their healing journey. Our counselling services support clients experiencing a broad range of concerns, including anxiety, depression, stress, grief and loss, trauma, relationship difficulties, self-esteem challenges, emotional overwhelm, life transitions, burnout, and personal development concerns.

name: Kunal Shah
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: I provide trauma-informed, research-based, and LGBTQIA+ affirming support for South Asians, young adults, families, couples, LGBTQIA+ communities, migrants, and students, with a focus on culturally sensitive, inclusive care. I integrate evidence-based approaches including CBT, ACT, Narrative Therapy, EFT/EFIT, Somatic Therapy, Art Therapy, and Inner Child Healing, combining therapeutic insight with practical tools for meaningful change beyond traditional talk therapy. My areas of focus include childhood trauma, anxiety, addiction, boundaries, bullying, abuse-related support, and navigating feelings of being stuck or overwhelmed.

name: Lam Luong
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I hold a Master of Counselling and a Bachelor of Psychological Science, supported by counselling experience gained through previous field placements working with young people. My training has equipped me with strong communication, research, and cultural sensitivity skills. In my private practice, i provide phone‑based counselling for young adults and adults of all ages, using a trauma‑informed, humanistic, and strengths‑based approach.
